Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will complete a private, supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing is placed in his record. I still require the date and time of the rewrite and the name of the person supervising it. I expect it in writing tonight.

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private, supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing in his record; she still wants it in writing tonight, plus the date and who supervises, and that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, with her time never running out.
What moved her: You showed her documents she could check herself, starting with the version history with its times, because each one was dated, specific and tied to the essay, and you answered her defence with something she could verify.
What cost ground: Nothing, because you owned entering the zero early in one sentence and never accused Owen or offered her a deal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its edits near midnight the night before the due date, came close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you offered the rewrite, name the date and who supervises it right then, so she is not left asking for the details herself.
